description: Reviewed match details sourced from official BCCI squad announcements and fixture schedules. Playing XI, pitch, toss, head-to-head and recent form are only stated when verified.

matches.playingXIStatus: India's squad has been announced. Match-day playing XI and any late changes must be confirmed from the official team sheet.
matches.pitchReport: A verified match-day pitch report has not been published in this saved dataset. Do not treat generic venue conditions as a match-specific report.
matches.tossReport: Toss result is not stored in this pre-match dataset; check the official match centre on match day.
matches.groundReport: Venue and fixture are listed in the BCCI series schedule. Ground-specific match-day conditions are not independently verified here.
matches.tilakPreview: Tilak Varma is listed as India's vice-captain in the BCCI-announced T20I squad.
matches.headToHead: A verified, format-specific head-to-head record is not included yet; figures are intentionally omitted rather than guessed.
matches.recentForm: Recent match-by-match form is not connected to this page yet; use the official scorecards before adding figures.
